camel_example: aliyun cms DescribeMetricLast --region cn-hangzhou --MetricName CPUUtilization --Namespace acs_ecs_dashboard
description_en: Queries the latest monitoring data of a specified metric
description_zh: 查询指定监控项的最新监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-metric-last --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --metric-name CPUUtilization --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMetricLast

parameters.help_en:
The namespace of the cloud service.

For information about namespaces of cloud services, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的数据命名空间。

关于云产品的数据命名空间，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The metric name of the cloud service.

For information about metric names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的监控项名称。

关于监控项名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en:
The statistical period of the monitoring data.

Valid values: 15, 60, 900, and 3600.

Unit: seconds.

If you do not set the statistical period, monitoring data is queried based on the reporting period that was specified when the metric was registered.
    - The statistical period varies by metric (`MetricName`) for each cloud service. For more information, see the `Min Periods` column on the metric list page of the target cloud service in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
监控数据的统计周期。

取值：15、60、900和3600。

单位：秒。

如果不设置统计周期，则按照注册监控项时申请的上报周期来查询监控数据。
    - 每个云产品的监控项（`MetricName`）的统计周期不同。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html中目标云产品**指标列表**页面中的1列
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The start time.

Two formats are supported: 1. A UNIX timestamp string in milliseconds (ms), which represents the number of milliseconds elapsed since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. 2. A time string in the ISO 8601 format of YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ in UTC.

The query range uses a left-exclusive and right-inclusive mode. StartTime cannot be equal to or greater than EndTime, and the interval between them must be less than or equal to 31 days
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。

支持两种格式：1. Unix 时间戳字符串，单位为毫秒（ms），即从 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起经过的毫秒数；2. ISO 8601 标准时间字符串，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，时区为 UTC。

查询范围执行左开右闭模式，StartTime 不能等于或大于 EndTime，且两者间隔需小于等于 31 天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time for querying the metric.

The system automatically limits the query start time (query window size) based on data granularity:
Second-level data: The maximum query span is 20 minutes (start time = Max(startTime, EndTime - 20min)).
Minute-level data: The maximum query span is 2 hours (start time = Max(startTime, EndTime - 2h)).
Hour-level data: The maximum query span is 2 days (start time = Max(startTime, EndTime - 2d)).

If the specified startTime is earlier than the limit, the system automatically uses the limit as the actual query start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询监控项的结束时间。

系统将根据数据精度自动限制查询的起始时间（即查询窗口大小）：
秒级数据：最大查询跨度为 20 分钟（起始时间 = Max(startTime, EndTime - 20min)）；
分钟级数据：最大查询跨度为 2 小时（起始时间 = Max(startTime, EndTime - 2h)）；
小时级数据：最大查询跨度为 2 天（起始时间 = Max(startTime, EndTime - 2d)）。

若传入的 startTime 早于上述限制时间，系统将自动使用限制时间作为实际查询起点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring dimensions of the specified resource.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs. Example: `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` or `{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`.

A maximum of 50 instances can be queried in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
指定资源的监控维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：`{"userId":"120886317861****"}`和`{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`。

单次请求最多支持批量查询50个实例
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en:
The pagination cursor.

If the query results that match the filter conditions exceed the page size, a pagination cursor is returned.
To retrieve the next page of data, use the returned cursor value as the request parameter until no cursor value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
分页游标的标识。

如果匹配查询条件的返回结果超过了分页大小，则会返回这个分页游标。
如果需要获取下一页数据，将返回的游标值作为请求参数即可，直到无游标值返回，表示已经获取了全部数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for monitoring data. This parameter is used for paged query.

Default value: 1000, which indicates 1000 entries of monitoring data per page.

The maximum value of Length in a single request is 1440
parameters.help_zh:
返回监控数据的每页大小，用于分页查询。

默认值：1000，即每页1000条监控数据。

单次请求Length的最大值为1440
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en: The expression for real-time computation on existing query results
parameters.help_zh: 对现有查询结果进行实时计算的表达式
parameters.name: express

Code.description_en:
The status code.
A value of 200 indicates success

Message.example: The specified resource is not found.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
